name: Farah Reyes
source: Passionate, fiery, strict and relentless, the qualities that propelled the newly-promoted Detective Reyes to the top of her class are the very same that make her a pain-in-the-ass as a partner. Uncompromising sounds good on paper, but in a city where bureaucracy is the law and corruption is the norm, opinionated cops tend to get shafted… or sent off to the dusty Homicide Department to keep the force’s fossils company.
